task_packet.goal: Validate R2, close deterministic Path A, issue exact Path B requests, and revalidate 08A1D mappings.
task_packet.context: R2 is immutable and R3 memberships are superseded audit history.
task_packet.scope: Sanitized evidence, local validators, documentation, and incremental graph/vector records.
constraints: No credential values, fragments, or candidate-derived tags
No commit, push, deployment, rotation, revocation, or deletion
requirements: One primary state per current R2 logical item
Path A uses current deterministic R2 proof only
Path B queue is one exact R2 class per request
08A1D mapping fails closed when retained coverage cannot be proven current
task_packet.done_when: All repository-local validation passes and only genuine external evidence remains.
